cases.claim: “No needles! Goodbye!” (Jingle, 0:04 and 0:53) | “Goodbye, needle fear.” (Audio voiceover (VO), 0:26)
cases.context: Repeat of concerns in Sept 9, 2025 Untitled Letter; PPI directs patients to get emergency help after use, which may involve injectables; SUPER on other injectable products does not mitigate.
cases.rationale: Implies patients can avoid all injectables and that needle fear is eliminated; unsupported.
cases.check: Do claims imply the product eliminates the need for other treatments or resolves an emotional state (e.g., fear) without evidence?

cases.claim: “Hello, getaways. Goodbye, stressful days.” (VO, 0:19) | “Hello, celebration. Goodbye, hesitation.” (VO, 0:22)
cases.rationale: Suggests patients need not worry or take allergen-avoidance precautions if they carry Neffy.
cases.check: Does the piece imply that having the product removes the need for precautionary behavior?

cases.claim: Multiple presentations (0:03, 0:06, 0:14 and 0:17) of the Neffy device out of its blister packaging and being placed in a carry case in various bags and a pocket.
cases.context: PPI: 'Store neffy nasal spray in the blister pack until ready to use.' Single-use device.
cases.rationale: Depicting improper storage risks accidental activation and inability to dose in emergency.
cases.check: Do visuals show storage/handling contrary to the label's storage instructions?
